## Tour Including VIK Winery: Wine Tasting and Lunch

At [VIK Winery](/chile/place/vik-winery/), an introduction to Chilean wine takes place against the hills of the Millahue Valley. The standalone [wine tasting and lunch excursion](/chile/vik-winery/vik-winery-tasting-lunch-from-santiago/) leaves from Santiago and occupies a full day. The programme includes an introduction to winemaking, a tasting of the estate's wines and lunch at a restaurant overlooking the vineyards.

This excursion module forms part of the [16-day tour “Hidden Treasures of Bolivia and Chile”](/multi-country/tour/bolivia-chile-hidden-treasures-16-days/). This section is therefore especially useful for travellers who want to combine a wine experience with the high-altitude and Patagonian parts of South America, rather than spending the entire trip visiting wineries.

## When the Wine Tasting Takes Place

The itinerary begins in Bolivia, visiting La Paz and the Uyuni Salt Flat, then crosses the border into Atacama. After Santiago, it heads to Patagonia, including Torres del Paine National Park and aquatic natural attractions in the Aysén Region. Only then does the group return to the Chilean capital.

**The visit to VIK is scheduled for day 13**, after the Marble Caves and the return from southern Chile. The next day includes a separate trip to [Valparaíso and Viña del Mar](/chile/valparaiso-vina-del-mar/valparaiso-vina-neruda-full-day/), and the journey concludes in Santiago.

In this sequence, the tasting offers a relaxed cultural and gastronomic break after a series of flights, border crossings and outdoor activities. It brings the trip to a close in a different way, through local wines, architecture and cuisine.

## Where VIK Is Located and How the Visit Works

The winery is situated in the [Millahue Valley](/chile/place/millahue-valley/) of the Cachapoal area, outside Santiago itself. The drive takes approximately **two hours each way**. The journey therefore needs a full day, even if the tasting itself is shorter.

VIK's architecture is integrated into the surrounding hills and vineyards. During the visit, travellers learn about the winemaking process, followed by a tasting and lunch. The specific wines and menu can vary with the date and format of the visit. The published itinerary describes the activity but does not establish a fixed list of wine labels or dishes.

After returning to [Santiago de Chile](/chile/place/santiago-de-chile/), the group stays overnight in the capital. An additional late transfer to another region is not included that day.

## How the Extended Tour Differs from a Conventional Wine Trip

| Comparison | Details |
|---|---|
| Main itinerary | Bolivia and Chile |
| Duration | 16 days, 15 nights |
| VIK | Day 13 |
| Format | Tasting and lunch |
| Departure | From Santiago |

In the 16-day programme, the winery is one cultural stop alongside the Uyuni Salt Flat, Atacama, Patagonia and the Pacific coast. If your main motivation is visiting several wineries and comparing wines from different regions, consider [food and wine tours in Chile](/interests/food-and-wine/tours/chile/). These let you choose a stronger wine focus without assuming that every route includes numerous tastings.

The extended tour suits those who want varied nature experiences followed by one substantial winery day. It is much more complex to organise than a short trip from the capital: additional countries, flights, mountain regions and travel across Patagonia require separate planning.

## What Is Actually Paid for in the Programme

The day includes a winery tour, tasting and lunch. However, **the tour listing does not publish a single confirmed price for the entire 16-day itinerary or a definitive item-by-item breakdown of included services**. Prices and conditions are quoted for the specific trip selected.

Before booking, Ada Tours agrees on the itinerary, hotels and transport, and separately confirms which winery services are included in the price calculation. This is particularly important if a traveller expects particular wines, a private format or special lunch arrangements. None of these are guaranteed in the available description.

A winery visit also does not eliminate the need to check rules for transporting purchases and alcohol on subsequent flights. Carriage limits are set by airlines and the customs regulations of the relevant route, so they should be verified against the actual tickets.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Tours Featuring VIK Winery

### Which tour includes a tasting at VIK?

The 16-day “Hidden Treasures of Bolivia and Chile” journey. The excursion takes place on day 13, after the return from Patagonia to Santiago.

### Is an overnight stay at the winery necessary?

No. It is a full-day trip from Santiago, returning to the capital. No separate hotel night at the winery is specified in this tour.

### Is lunch included in the VIK visit?

Yes, the standalone excursion description includes lunch at a restaurant overlooking the valley. When booking the extended tour, its actual inclusion in the price calculation must be confirmed.

### Can I choose the exact wine to taste?

The published description does not specify a fixed wine list. It promises a tasting of VIK estate wines; the exact selection and arrangements are agreed separately.

### Can I combine VIK and Valparaíso in one day?

In the current 16-day itinerary, these visits are on **different days**: VIK on day 13 and the coastal cities on day 14. This is a more relaxed schedule than trying to add a long drive to the Pacific after a winery visit.

## Excursion to the Flower Clock in Viña del Mar

The [Flower Clock](/chile/place/vina-flower-clock/) is one of the symbols of the Chilean city of Viña del Mar. Its plant-covered clock face sits on a slope near the coast. It is a convenient place to see how this resort city combines urban gardens with views of the Pacific.

The clock was created for the **1962 FIFA World Cup**, when the city hosted matches. Its floral decorations are refreshed throughout the year, so the colours and patterns vary by season.

## Which Ada Tours Excursions Include the Flower Clock?

The attraction is part of the [“Valparaíso, Viña del Mar and Pablo Neruda's House” excursion](/chile/valparaiso-vina-del-mar/valparaiso-vina-neruda-full-day/). This is a **full-day trip from Santiago** combining two neighbouring cities with very different atmospheres.

The first part of the route explores historic Valparaíso. It includes [Plaza Sotomayor](/chile/place/plaza-sotomayor/), walks along [Paseo Gervasoni](/chile/place/paseo-gervasoni/) and Paseo Atkinson, and viewpoints on Cerro Concepción. Travellers then continue to Viña del Mar.

Here you will see the **Flower Clock**, seafront, Reñaca Beach and the Fonck Museum. The day's excursion also includes Pablo Neruda's house, La Sebastiana. Afterwards, the route returns to Santiago.

The Flower Clock occupies only one part of the broader sightseeing day. This stop alone should not be taken as a promise of ample independent time to explore the resort city.

## What to See Near the Clock

The most recognisable view is the floral clock face and its moving hands. It stands on an open slope close to Caleta Abarca Beach. The pedestrian path offers a good place to take photographs without stepping onto the flowerbeds.

A defining feature of the city is its proximity to the ocean. Compared with the port city of Valparaíso and its steep residential hills, Viña del Mar feels more like a seaside resort on this coastline.

If you plan to see other places in the city, confirm the time available for walking before booking. On a combined day trip, most of the schedule is already allocated to other attractions.

## Practical Planning

Allow a little extra time for photos at the clock: it is popular, and tour groups may be nearby. It is worth agreeing on the priorities for a combined trip, since Valparaíso's history, architecture, beaches and museums call for different amounts of attention.

Other journeys in the region can be found in our [Chile tours catalogue](/chile/tour/).

## Frequently Asked Questions About the Flower Clock

### Where is the Flower Clock?

In **Viña del Mar**, near Caleta Abarca Beach on Chile's Pacific coast.

### Is it a real working clock?

Yes. The flowers form the clock face, while the hands show the time.

### Is the stop included in a trip from Santiago?

Yes. The clock is listed in the [Valparaíso and Viña del Mar sightseeing excursion](/chile/valparaiso-vina-del-mar/valparaiso-vina-neruda-full-day/).

### Can I swim at the beach after seeing the clock?

Reñaca Beach is listed among the itinerary's stops, but separate time for swimming must be agreed in advance. Such arrangements require individual confirmation.

## Barú and Agua Azul: A Beach Day from Cartagena

After exploring the historic centre of [Cartagena](/colombia/place/cartagena/), you can set aside a day to relax by the Caribbean Sea. Our programme offers a visit to **Agua Azul Beach** on [Barú](/colombia/place/baru-island/), with daytime access to the hotel grounds, sun loungers and beach towels.

Barú is often called an island, although geographically it is a peninsula by Cartagena Bay. It can be reached by road or water. The return journey includes **a speedboat departure at 17:00** followed by a transfer to your Cartagena hotel. The morning arrival arrangements must be agreed separately.

## How Agua Azul Differs from a City Tour

This day is devoted to the sea and relaxation. The Barú area is known for pale sand and clear Caribbean water, and the coastal environment contrasts with Cartagena's busy streets. The peninsula's beaches are not identical: Playa Blanca, Agua Azul and other stretches have different facilities, visitor numbers and access rules.

The excursion includes the use of sun loungers and towels at Agua Azul. Guests can divide their time between swimming and resting on the shore. However, **food, drinks, diving, snorkelling and other water activities are not listed as included services**. A restaurant or extra activities offered by third parties do not become part of the Ada Tours package.

## The Route and Return to Cartagena

| Stage | Programme |
|---|---|
| Barú | Beach relaxation |
| Agua Azul | Sun loungers and towels |
| 17:00 | Return by speedboat |
| Cartagena | Transfer to the hotel |

The journey from Cartagena to Barú is estimated at around 40 minutes, but this guideline is not tied to a particular transport mode or departure point. It cannot be treated as a guaranteed transfer duration in every case.

The 17:00 time refers to the boat's return departure, not arrival at the hotel. Sea conditions, boarding and the road transfer may affect the total return time. Allow a buffer if you have other evening plans.

## How to Prepare

For a day by the sea, take sun protection, a hat, water, swimwear and dry clothing. Keeping documents and your phone in a waterproof case is useful on the boat.

Before departure, agree on the meeting point, transport to Barú, available facilities, meals and payment for extras. Swimming and boat operations depend on actual weather and staff instructions. Do not assume that the terms of other beach packages apply here.

## Who Is This Programme For?

The trip suits travellers who want to spend a day by the sea after exploring [Colombia](/colombia/) and return to Cartagena in the evening. It can be considered alongside other [beach holidays](/interests/beach-holidays/), but their included services should not be attributed to Agua Azul.

This product does not include an overnight stay on Barú or a maritime expedition. Separate activities must be agreed and priced in addition.

## Frequently Asked Questions About a Beach Day at Agua Azul

### Are sun loungers and towels included?

The description includes daytime use of the Agua Azul hotel grounds, with sun loungers and towels. Other services should be checked against the chosen offer.

### When does the return boat depart?

At **17:00**. After returning to Cartagena, a transfer to the hotel is arranged.

### Is lunch included?

Meals are not listed among the confirmed included services. Lunch and drinks must be arranged separately.

### Is there an overnight stay on Barú?

No. This is a daytime beach outing with a return to Cartagena.

## Tours Featuring a Trip to Agua Azul Beach on Barú

After walking through the old neighbourhoods of [Cartagena](/colombia/place/cartagena/), many travellers want a day by the Caribbean Sea. A [Barú trip with time at Agua Azul Beach](/colombia/baru-island/colombia-baru-agua-azul-day-trip/) offers just that: a sandy shore, clear water and time to relax after busy sightseeing days. “Barú Island” is a common name in travel itineraries, although geographically Barú is a peninsula.

Our selection contains {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} featuring this outing. When choosing an itinerary, check **whether a free day remains in Cartagena and whether the trip to Barú is charged as an extra**. A standalone beach excursion has different terms from hotel accommodation included in a multi-day tour.

## Barú on an Itinerary Through Peru and Colombia

The first part of the [14-day “Discovering Peru and Colombia” journey](/multi-country/tour/peru-colombia-discovery/) visits [Lima](/peru/place/lima/), [Cusco](/peru/place/cusco/), [Machu Picchu](/peru/place/machu-picchu/) and Lake Titicaca. Travellers then continue to Colombia, exploring Bogotá, Lake Guatavita and the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá before heading to Cartagena.

A beach day on [Barú](/colombia/place/baru-island/) appears as a separate optional excursion after the time in Cartagena, before the final day's flight via Bogotá. However, **the tour's exclusions explicitly state that the day-13 trip to Barú is paid for when booked as an optional extra**. The budget should account for this condition.

{{catalog.tourTable:tour_source_manyashchij_peru_kolumbiya}}

This journey suits those who want to combine Andean landmarks, colonial cities and a final break on the Caribbean coast. If several unhurried days on the beach are your primary goal, compare [other tours of Colombia](/colombia/tour/) and check how much time they actually allocate to the coast.

## How a Day at Agua Azul Works

The standalone Barú excursion includes daytime access to Agua Azul with sun loungers and beach towels. **The return speedboat to Cartagena is scheduled for 17:00**, after which a hotel transfer is provided.

| Stage | Included arrangement |
|---|---|
| Cartagena | Departure towards Barú |
| Agua Azul Beach | Time by the sea |
| 17:00 | Return speedboat |
| Return | Hotel transfer |

Travel time on the water depends on the actual transport and conditions. The 17:00 return applies to the standalone Agua Azul programme; different beaches or routes around the Rosario Islands may have different schedules.

The standalone excursion description does not provide a detailed table of included meals, drinks and beach services. Before booking, therefore, confirm whether your rate covers travel to the pier, boat transport, beach facilities, lunch and possible local fees. The broad description “beach day” does not define everything paid for.

## Why the Return Must Be Coordinated with Flights

Cartagena often marks the end of a journey focused on culture. On the [Peru and Colombia tour](/multi-country/tour/peru-colombia-discovery/), the beach day is followed by a flight from Cartagena to Bogotá and a connection to an international departure. Returning from Barú the day before travel allows time for a hotel night and packing.

If travellers have other flight tickets, a different schedule may be needed. Boat services depend on weather and navigation conditions, while getting to the airport also takes time on city roads. If the trip ends with a morning flight, it is best to discuss moving the beach day earlier.

Travellers chiefly interested in the Caribbean coast can explore our [selection of beach tours in Colombia](/interests/beach-holidays/tours/colombia/). The separate [Barú destination page](/colombia/place/baru-island/) introduces the area independently of an extended tour programme.

## What to Compare Before Booking

First decide how many days to devote to historic cities, mountains and the coast. Then check the specific beach, the time left for relaxation and arrangements for the boat and return transfer.

We can help coordinate the Agua Azul trip with your Cartagena itinerary, overnight stay and onward flights. Send a link to the [specific programme](/multi-country/tour/peru-colombia-discovery/) and indicate how many days you would like to spend by the sea.

## Frequently Asked Questions About Tours with a Beach Day on Barú

### Is the Barú excursion included in the 14-day Peru and Colombia tour?

No. The base service list for [this tour](/multi-country/tour/peru-colombia-discovery/) identifies it as an optional excursion on day 13, purchased for an additional charge.

### What time do travellers return from Agua Azul?

The standalone excursion schedules the speedboat's return departure at 17:00, followed by a transfer to the Cartagena hotel.

### Can visitors spend several days on Barú?

This depends on the chosen multi-day itinerary and accommodation. The Agua Azul product described here is a one-day beach excursion, not a multi-night stay.

### Are Barú and the Rosario Islands the same place?

They are different geographical and excursion destinations off the Caribbean coast near Cartagena. When choosing, check which specific beach and transport your tour includes.

## Excursion to Barú from Cartagena: A Beach Day at Agua Azul

**Barú near Cartagena is a popular destination for beach holidays on Colombia's Caribbean coast.** You can choose our [“Barú Island: Beach Day at Agua Azul” excursion](/colombia/baru-island/colombia-baru-agua-azul-day-trip/). It is designed for relaxing by the sea after a city sightseeing programme: daytime access to Agua Azul includes sun loungers and beach towels, with a return journey arranged for the evening.

This is different from a sightseeing tour of historic Cartagena or a multi-day stay in a separate hotel on Barú. Learn more about the coast and accommodation on our [Barú destination page](/colombia/place/baru-island/).

## What's Included in the Beach Day

| Stage | Confirmed inclusion |
|---|---|
| Barú — Agua Azul | Daytime relaxation |
| Beach | Loungers and towels |
| Return | Boat and transfer |

Our excursion includes **daytime access to Agua Azul**, with sun loungers and beach towels. After relaxing, the **17:00** return trip is arranged **by speedboat to Cartagena**, followed by a transfer to the hotel.

Daytime access does not automatically include booking a room overnight. The beach day's start time, boarding point and other transport details to Barú are agreed separately. When booking, also clarify meals, drinks and additional water activities, which are not listed among the included services.

## Barú: An Island by Name, a Peninsula by Geography

Although “Barú Island” is widely used in tour programmes, Colombia Travel's official portal explains that **Barú is geographically a peninsula**. It is bordered by the Caribbean Sea, Cartagena Bay and the Dique Canal. It can be reached by boat or by road, while our excursion specifically includes the evening return by water.

Conditions differ across Barú's beaches. One stretch may be lively and crowded, another quieter; access arrangements, beachfront services and transport also vary.

**Agua Azul** is generally chosen for spending time by the sea. The main experience is warm Caribbean air, a pale shoreline and clear water, rather than visiting a long succession of attractions. Do not assume that this excursion includes services or activities available on neighbouring beaches.

## How Agua Azul Differs from Other Barú Beaches

Barú is also known for **Playa Blanca, Cholón and Agua Tranquila**. Colombia Travel describes them as different types of beach experiences: Playa Blanca attracts large numbers of visitors; Cholón is associated with boats and a livelier atmosphere; Agua Azul and Agua Tranquila are suited to more relaxed beach days.

These are general descriptions of the areas, not a promise of perfect peace and quiet on a particular date. If seclusion matters, confirm the exact beach zone, capacity and seasonal visitor numbers before choosing.

We organise trips specifically to **Agua Azul**. Visits to other beaches, party programmes at Cholón or a separate journey through the Rosario Islands are not included by default.

## Combining Barú with Cartagena

[Cartagena](/colombia/place/cartagena/) attracts visitors with its old town, fortifications, squares and Caribbean architecture. A beach day on Barú fits well after a busy day of city sightseeing: the following day can be spent by the water, returning to your hotel in the evening.

However, a day on Barú should not also be counted as a full sightseeing tour of the historic centre. Travellers who want to visit Cartagena's forts and museums need separate time. Compare options in the [Colombia excursions catalogue](/colombia/excursion/) and browse [tours of Colombia](/colombia/tour/) that combine different regions.

Transfer time from Cartagena depends on the point of departure, route and traffic. An approximate journey time to Barú given for this excursion is not a universal guaranteed transfer duration from every hotel or pier.

## What to Bring for a Beach Day

For the Caribbean sunshine, bring a hat, sunscreen, water and light clothing. Since loungers and towels are included in our programme, they should not automatically be treated as extra paid services for this particular product. However, costs for meals, drinks, equipment hire and other activities need to be confirmed separately.

Wind and sea conditions in the Caribbean can change. A speedboat may rock noticeably, especially on the return journey after a day in the sun. If you need special boarding arrangements, have limited mobility or are travelling with young children, discuss this before booking.

Barú can also be a place for longer beach holidays, but overnight stays are separate hotel offers rather than part of the daytime [Agua Azul excursion](/colombia/baru-island/colombia-baru-agua-azul-day-trip/).

## Frequently Asked Questions About the Barú Excursion

### Where is Agua Azul?

It is a beach area on Barú near Cartagena on Colombia's Caribbean coast. The precise landing point and guest area depend on the chosen excursion.

### Are loungers and towels included?

Yes. The description of the [Agua Azul beach day](/colombia/baru-island/colombia-baru-agua-azul-day-trip/) lists them as part of the daytime facilities.

### What time is the return scheduled?

The published itinerary specifies **17:00** for the return speedboat to Cartagena, followed by a hotel transfer. Details are confirmed for the date.

### Can visitors stay on Barú overnight?

There are hotels on Barú, but this particular excursion is **a day trip**. Overnight accommodation must be arranged separately.

### Are lunch and snorkelling included?

The current excursion description does not confirm these as included services. Their availability and prices must be checked at booking.
